content_sections.heading: RCB Project-JRF Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the RCB Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download RCB Project-JRF Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: M.Sc. in life sciences with NET/DBT-JRF/GATE or equivalent exam cleared with Masters or equivalent degree.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 26 years. Age relaxation will be as per government rules. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for RCB Project-JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project-JRF post at Regional Centre for Biotechnology is scheduled for 24 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they report on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project-JRF position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. degree in life sciences and have cleared the NET/DBT-JRF/GATE or an equivalent examination. A Master's or equivalent degree is mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project-JRF post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project-JRF position is 26 years as of 30 September 2026. Age relaxation may be applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project-JRF role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project-JRF position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000/- plus 27% HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Project-JRF position at RCB?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview. Candidates need to report at the specified venue on the interview date with all required documents.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the RCB Project-JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original educational certificates, ID proof, experience certificates (if any), category certificates (if applicable), and one set of self-attested photocopies of these documents.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Project-JRF post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project-JRF position announced by the Regional Centre for Biotechnology.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a walk-in interview followed by document verification. Candidates need to perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Regional Centre for Biotechnology located?
faq.answer: The Regional Centre for Biotechnology is located in Faridabad, Haryana, with the pincode 121001.
